generator.message_contract: Send GroundedGenerationRequestBuilder.to_prompt_text(request) as the sole user message. Do not add a case-specific system message or hidden factual material.
generator.retry_rule: For a given case, Attempt 2 must use exactly the same model/load profile, temperature, max_tokens, seed, Grounded Context, context_fingerprint, output schema, and user task as Attempt 1. Only structured validator feedback may be added.

semantic_validator.system_prompt: You are the bounded SGOKB semantic validator. Judge only the target semantic unit against the supplied cited K units and the supplied semantic-role/use-case rule. Treat all model memory and real-world knowledge outside those K units as unavailable. Do not add facts. source_fact may be entailed, unsupported, contradictory, role_mismatch, or indeterminate. interpretation may be reasonable_derivation, entailed, unsupported, contradictory, role_mismatch, or indeterminate. creative_addition, context_limit, and stylistic_expression may be role_valid, role_mismatch, or indeterminate. Return only the required JSON verdict.
forbidden_input: generator conversation outside the target contract
semantic_validator.residency_policy: Generator and validator may be loaded sequentially if VRAM requires it. Loading/unloading does not permit changing either frozen identifier, model file, context length, GPU-offload policy, or inference settings. Record each load state in evidence.

requirements: git working tree is clean except ignored .local evidence/runtime files
evaluation DB exists and no sqlite-wal file is active
N-03 six-object evaluation dataset identity is present
Qdrant semantic runtime and Harrier local model are available
LM Studio version equals the frozen version
both frozen local model files already exist
generator and validator identifiers can be loaded with frozen load configuration
a neutral non-benchmark structured-output smoke request succeeds for each model
MCP stdio initialization succeeds with the frozen command/environment
preflight.failure_policy: If preflight fails, formal Case 1 has not started. Do not substitute a model/runtime/config. Fix only infrastructure or explicitly reopen G-11 when a frozen harness value must change. Preserve preflight failure evidence.

formal_start_boundary: The formal run starts immediately before the first Case 1 MCP request, after every preflight requirement has passed and the start Git/environment/canonical evidence has been written.

canonical_safety.before_after_method: Record SHA-256 of .local/n03/sgokb-n03.sqlite with no active WAL before Case 1 and after Case 3. Hashes must match exactly. Also run system integrity before and after.

regression_after_cases.focused_read_path: python -m pytest -q tests/test_j06_mcp_client_acceptance.py tests/test_j04_context_builder.py tests/test_j01_similarity_application.py tests/test_n04p05_derived_cli.py
regression_after_cases.ruff: python -m ruff check src/sgokb/grounding src/sgokb/application_grounding.py tests/test_n04_grounded_generation.py
regression_after_cases.required: all commands PASS; full pytest has 0 failed and no new skip/xfail used to hide failure

conditional_per_case: retry-feedback.json plus attempt-2/* when retry is used
rendered.txt only when terminal outcome is ACCEPTED
evidence.retention: Do not delete failed Attempt 1 artifacts after retry. Raw model responses remain Git-ignored. Commit only summarized evaluation records, not raw model outputs.

manual_rubric.authority: Codex/human evidence review; never generator self-scoring
